Package net.maswag.falcaun.oracle

package net.maswag.falcaun.oracle
Membership and equivalence oracles used in black-box checking.

NumericMembershipOracle answers membership queries by executing a NumericSUL and caches the abstract outputs and the robustness values. The robustness-guided equivalence oracles, e.g., HillClimbingEQOracle, SAEQOracle, and GAEQOracle, search for counterexamples minimizing the robustness obtained through a RobustnessOracle. They are usually configured through NumericSULVerifier rather than constructed directly.
